speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs in each of the past five years (a) what is the number of suspicious real estate transaction reports filed; and (b) what is the number of convictions on money laundering involving (i) residential real estate and (ii) commercial real estate in Singapore.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: Just one supplementary question for the Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: I think I understand that the requirements for developers to take certain anti-money laundering (AML) actions against money laundering will be effective from June of this year.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: So, to that extent, I wanted to ask what sort of safeguards will be put in place for secondary market transactions.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: The reason being especially if the developers actually put in place such safeguards for primary market transactions, then, potentially the bad actors could even turn to secondary market transactions should they have such intentions.
